within_breeding_site_list: NONE — NO BREEDING SITES ANYWHERE NEAR THE SCHOOL BUILDINGS
SOME — BREEDING SITES PRESENT NEAR SOME BUT NOT ALL BUILDINGS
ALL — BREEDING SITES PRESENT NEAR ALL SCHOOL BUILDINGS
outside_breeding_site_list: NONE — NO BREEDING SITES ANYWHERE NEAR THE SCHOOL BUILDINGS
SOME — BREEDING SITES PRESENT NEAR SOME BUT NOT ALL BUILDINGS
ALL — BREEDING SITES PRESENT NEAR ALL SCHOOL BUILDINGS
bednets_hung_list: YES, ALMOST ALL BEDS — A NET IS HUNG OVER ALMOST EVERY BED IN DORMITORY (90-100%)
YES, MORE THAN HALF — NETS PRESENT OVER THE MAJORITY OF BEDS BUT NOT ALL (65-90%)
YES, HALF—NETS PRESENT OVER ROUGHLY HALF OF THE BEDS (40 -64%)
YES, FEWER THAN HALF — NETS PRESENT BUT COVERING FEWER THAN HALF OF BEDS (LESS THAN 40 %)
NONE, OR VERY FEW — ALMOST NO BED NETS ARE HUNG IN ANY DORMITORY (0-10%)
bednet_condn_list: GOOD - MOST NETS LOOK NEW AND ARE INTACT WITH NO VISIBLE HOLES;
MIXED - SOME NETS INTACT, SOME DAMAGED
POOR - MOST NETS VISIBLY DAMAGED OR TORN
bednet_type_list: UNET G3 - PBO-ENHANCED FOR RESISTANT MOSQUITOES
